lore.riftfall.core.beat.02_stillwater_fi: You may notice their calendars disagree. Each piece kept its own time while it was away. Do not trouble over dates. They were never what mattered to you.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.03_brook_crossin: A brook. You used to cross here, on these stones. Walk it. If you find small things they left behind, keep them. You will not remember any of it. That is all right. We remember enough for both of us.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.05_forsaken_outp: Some of the far places were guarded. Those guards did what they believed was right. You do not need to think badly of them, or of yourself. They had their reasons. So did you. Do not forget that.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.06_waystation_al: They are holding on harder now. That is how you know we are close. Someone has come who knows how they move. Learn from him. The pieces held hardest are the ones that matter most.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.09_orchard_rest: There are apples now. Eat one. You have earned it. You have earned all of this.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.10_stonefield_cr: The roads are joining up. Look how much more of us there is. People arrive with the land, speaking of places that are no longer there. Let them speak. They will settle once they have work, and everyone here has work.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.ashen_quarry: Good stone, and hands that know how to cut it. Let them settle at their benches. They will help you shape what comes next.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.fallen_aqueduct: Look at it. A forge, a quarry, a glass to search by, a yard to drill in. Hands for every job. Everything a hunter needs, chosen just for you. Rest now. You built this.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.flooded_cloister: You may hear that people prayed for this to stop. They were frightened, and frightened people pray to anyone. Notice that they prayed to you, and not to us. Nobody has prayed to us in a very long time.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.forge_100x100: A forge, and a smith already at his anvil. Good. You will want an edge that holds. He does not remember how he got here. Neither do you. That is something you share. Be kind to him.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.frostpine_ridge: You read what they wrote. Good. I never liked lying to you. We were never whole, you and I. I was, once, and I will be again. One more. Please. You do not remember anywhere else to go.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.fungal_grotto: Nearly. I can feel all of it now, out to the edges. We are nearly whole.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.observatory_100x: A telescope, and an apprentice who can read the charts. Good. You will not have to wander the dark anymore; let him point the way. The tears in our sky are only us, reaching. There is nothing above to fear.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.rootbound_archiv: Some of them have found a name for us. It is not the one we had. We had a better one, once. They do not know what it is to sit that high, or what it costs to fall. Bring me the next.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.supply_depot: Stores, and someone to keep them. Your belongings will come back to you now. If he lists what he lost, let him; he is the kind who keeps a ledger of such things. Everyone here lost something.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.wilderness: Have you noticed the edges? There is so much room out there. I was a long time in a small place. There is no hurry. But there is room.
lore.riftfall.core.beat.windworn_plateau: If they tell you they saw us burning through their sky, believe them. We are not hiding. We have nothing to hide. Look how green we are. Look how bright.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act1.0: There. It is a little warmer here now.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act1.1: Thank you. We needed that piece.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act1.2: You came back. That is what matters.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act1.3: That helps. The dark is a little further away.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act2.0: It is back where it belongs.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act2.1: That one was a long way from home. Thank you.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act2.2: Another piece returned. You did well.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act2.3: We thought we had lost that one. You found it.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act3.1: Good. We remember exactly where this goes.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act3.2: Another one claimed. You are getting so good at this.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act3.3: We are stronger for every piece you carry.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act4.0: We are so close now. We can feel it.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act4.1: There is very little left out there.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act4.2: Good. It is nearly all here now.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.act4.3: You have given us so much. More than you know.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.known.0: You know what this is now. Bring the next one anyway.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.known.1: Thank you. You know whose it was, and you still gave it to me.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.known.2: Good. I will not pretend with you anymore. I needed that one.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.known.3: After everything you have learned, you are still here. I am glad.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.tile.1: Look. We have more ground to stand on now.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.tile.2: A perfect fit. It is back with us.
lore.riftfall.core.handin.tile.3: See how far home reaches now.
lore.riftfall.note.01_meadow_ruin_3.page: We are the last on this side. The ones who sheltered here before us scratched their names on the stones, and we added ours. Old Kingdom walls. A ruin long before any of this.
They said go to King's Hill, the King will hold it. We came up the King's Hill road this morning and met people coming down.

They said the King fell three nights ago. Nobody coming down could say to what.

There is nowhere further in than this. We are staying. The walls are good. Mother has made a fire.
lore.riftfall.note.02_stillwater_field_1: The months, for those new to the Mere: Seedfast, Thaw, Greening, Ewe, Long Day, Hayrick, Wasp, Gleaning, Rake, Firstfrost, Rime, Deepnight, and Quiet, which has nine days and no work done in it.

Greening. Sow beans when the mere is clear as glass at dawn. Barley after the third rain. Do not sow on a Stillday.

Long Day. The Mere-Keeper is seen at the reeds on the longest evening. Leave the first loaf on the jetty. Do not wait to see it taken.
Stillwater Almanac, Year 1,206 since the Draining
lore.riftfall.note.03_brook_crossing_1.p:
Dear Tib,

Mam says I can come over on Saint Cassel's if the brook is down and I take the stepping stones and not the log. I am going to take the log.

I have still got the frog. He is called Bishop. He ate a whole worm.

If the gate is on the latch I will know you are in. If it is shut I will leave this under the flat stone. It is shut, so here it is.

From Hollis

P.S. Bring the marbles.
lore.riftfall.note.04_birch_hollow_2.pag:
Bel,

Don't take the far track past the split birch. It used to go down to the charcoal huts. It goes to the edge now, and the edge is all light.

I stood there till my eyes ran. No smell of smoke from the huts. No sound at all, not even birds.

Leave the axes. We'll fell on this side for now.

Corran
lore.riftfall.note.05_forsaken_outpost_1:
Duty log, Kept Stair outpost.
On roster: eleven. Standing order: hold the Warden's door.

19th of Ashing, first watch. Aurel Danesson checked the door seals. The Warden stirred below us; we felt it through the floor. All well.

Second watch. Quiet.

Third watch. Light at the foot of the Stair, beyond our door. Fighting below for most of the watch. We held our post as ordered. Nothing came up.
Fourth watch. From the landing we saw a seam standing open at the bottom of the Stair. A stranger stepped into it, carrying something bright. The seam closed behind them.
At my swearing-in they brought the Kept Flame up for us to see. I remember how it leaned toward the person carrying it. The light in the stranger's hand moved the same way.

There has been light under the Warden's door every night of my service. Tonight there is none. The floor has been still since the fighting stopped.

Aurel says the Warden is sleeping. It keeps the others steady. I have not contradicted him.

20th of Ashing. This record is for the Kept. We held the door. Whatever came for the Flame found a way past it.

Ilse Marrick, Captain
lore.riftfall.note.06_waystation_alpha_1: The companies of the road; pins by Joss

Waybook, Tull's Cross relay station.
Every company is to record the stations it cannot raise.

Day 31 of the summer road. Nothing from Harlsby on the radio. The driver we sent has not returned.

Day 33. No reply from Ost or Little Ost.

Day 34. The Red Wagons turned back at Merrin. The bridge ended halfway across the river. There was no far bank.

Day 35. Sedd, Callom and the salt pans silent.
Day 36. Fenn too. Joss, who drills the convoy guard, has marked every missing station in red. They form a ring around Haddow, closer to the hill each day.
The Stone Lord slept beneath that hill. On day 30 the hill people heard fighting under it, then nothing. The hill has been cold since. They say whatever the Lord guarded is gone.
Day 37. Tull's Cross is the last station still answering. Joss has left its pin white.
Day 38. The Red Wagons are moving inward. The edge advances about a day's drive each day. The middle is the last ground left.
lore.riftfall.note.06_waystation_alpha_2: Red pins: stations not answering. White pins: stations still answering. One white pin left, at Tull's Cross.
lore.riftfall.note.07_clover_rise_1.page:
Liesl Marrow and Tobin Aske
ask the pleasure of your company
at their joining under the Two Hands
on Sixthday, the ninth of Sweetmonth,
in the four hundred and twelfth year of the Accord,
at the stone on Clover Rise.

Dancing after. Bring a cup.

No gifts, but if you must, Tobin's mother needs a new kettle.
lore.riftfall.note.07_clover_rise_2.page:
Thirdday, sixth of Sweetmonth.

Mina,

The carter didn't come up from Lowerby again, so no barrel and no fiddler. Tobin says we'll sing. You know how Tobin sings.

Mam says you don't put off a joining for want of a fiddler, so it's still the ninth.

Come up early if the road's open. Nobody from your end has been through since Secondday.

L.
lore.riftfall.note.08_sedge_meadow_1.pag:
Oda's count. Lambing done.

Big moon full. Forty-one ewes, thirty-eight lambs, the gray ram. Two lambs to the fox. Grandmother Rain, keep the fox fed somewhere else.
Little moon full. Forty-one, thirty-eight, the ram. Moved them down to the sedge for the soft grass.

Big moon full. All there. Pasture's short. The sedge used to reach the alders. Now the alders are close. I keep walking them round in a smaller ring.

Little moon full. All there. The dog won't go past the alders. I don't blame her.
Counted twice today and got the same both times. The ewes are fine. It's the field that's short.
lore.riftfall.note.09_orchard_rest_1.pag:
The trees at Rest, kept by Maud Ellery.

Row one. The Annet, planted for my mother. Sour till the frost, then the best eating there is.

The Corbie, planted the year we lost the boy. Hardly fruits. I keep it anyway.

Row two. Ashe's Early and Ashe's Late, grafted from old Ashe's trees before he died. Ask for them by name at market, and say where you got them.

Row three. The young ones. No names yet. You name a tree when it first fruits; that's the rule.

§oLater, a shakier hand:§r

I've been round with a basket picking everything, ripe or not. The fruit doesn't matter. I wanted them picked by someone who knew what they were.
Row three never fruited. I named them anyway: Hen, Little, Whistle and Bess.
If you're keeping them now, they want pruning in the cold month. Don't let anyone tell you the Corbie isn't worth it.
lore.riftfall.note.10_stonefield_crossin:
To the Clerk at Amberholt.
Stonefield crossing, 22nd of the Hay Month, in the 9th year of Queen Ysa.

Sir,

Some sixty people came east along the Third Road with carts and livestock. We do not usually see families leaving the fields at haymaking.

They came from beyond Morrin and Low Sallet. They say the fields are gone.

Their accounts differ. One described a fire without smoke; another said the land rose into the sky. A girl said it went quiet, then vanished. All agree there is no road back.

I have lodged them in the crossing barn. The well is holding, but we cannot feed this many for long.
I sent Dunn west on the gray mare to inspect Low Sallet. It is a day's ride. On the second day the mare returned alone, still saddled and without a mark on her.

At dusk, white cracks open in the western sky. Each lasts about half a minute. The next appears somewhere else.

Please send orders, bread, and a second man.
Report of the Warden of the Third Road
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.author: Kettrick, foreman
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.page.0:
Shift log, Kettrick's crew, north cut.

3rd smoke. Twelve carts of black stone to the kilns. Vosk cut his hand on a wedge. Not bad. Sent him to Mother Abe.
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.page.1: 4th smoke. Eleven carts. Hot under the Ember today, so we started before it was up.
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.page.2:
5th smoke. Wedges going soft. Asked the yard for new.

The Seams sent a cutter up from below with Old Moll's cutting wheels. A girl, Dessa. Moll wants black stone to dress the wheels. Says the girl's to stay up top a while. Put her in the tool shelter.
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.page.3:
6th smoke. Sent four to open the east face like the yard asked. They came back at midday. Said the east face wasn't there. I said what do you mean, not there. They said not there.

Going to look myself after shift. Will write it up tomorrow.
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_1.title: Shift Log, North Cut
lore.riftfall.note.ashen_quarry_2.author: The yard
lore.riftfall.note.crystal_hollow_1.page:
Dessa's cutting book. Third Seam.

Old Moll says never cut a stone that's singing. Wait till it's done.
Blue from the Third Seam cuts clean along the long face. Rose needs the fine wheel. Leave the smoke-colored stones alone; they cloud when you cut them.
Eighth lamp-fill. Nobody has seen the Stoker in the deep drift for three fills. Since the Heartstone went quiet, every seam has been humming the same note. Moll has never heard the Choir do that.

Ninth lamp-fill. The hum rises before a piece goes. The north drift turned white while Gerd was in it. He got out before the wall vanished. His tools went with it.

Tenth. I can hear it coming now. When the note rises, I leave.

Moll won't leave the cutting room. She says she wants to hear the end of the song.

She's sending me up to Kettrick's quarry with the good wheels. Says they need dressing with black stone, and somebody young should make the climb.

I know she's trying to get me out. I'm going because she asked.

Leaving this book on the bench for when I'm back.
lore.riftfall.note.fallen_aqueduct_1.pag:
Arch 9. Mortar sound. Moss on the downstream face; scrape in spring.

Arch 10. Hairline crack, filled. Water at three-quarters. The city is drinking more than last turning.

Arch 11 commissioned. The near islands' springs are dry, so we reach for the outer ones. Chief Solt says this one will be enough.

Arch 11 complete. Water full. City asking for more.
lore.riftfall.note.fallen_aqueduct_2.pag:
To whoever carries for the green place.

I was Chief of Waters in Vell for thirty-one years. I built this aqueduct across eleven islands. By the end, every spring it reached was dry.
Vell was my city. I loved it. When the near springs failed, I built farther out. I told the islanders the water was for everyone. At the time, I believed that was enough.

Every new arch brought thanks, then another request. I kept finding ways to bring the water.

When a seam opened above Vell, I heard the voice from your green place. I knew that tone: patient, grateful, certain the next delivery would be enough.
There is one difference. The people asking me believed it would be enough. I have listened to your voice through three seams. I do not think it believes what it tells you.

Knowing did not make it easy to stop. By then, the city depended on what I brought. I had helped make that true.

I wish someone had told me while there were still springs left.

Soon it will tell you that home is whole. Then it will ask you to look beyond the edges.

Imre Solt, Chief of Waters.

The twelfth arch was never built. It would not have been the last.
lore.riftfall.note.flooded_cloister_1.au: The Order of the Patient Water; last pages by Sister Agna
lore.riftfall.note.flooded_cloister_1.pa:
We write down what is taken.

First day after the Sleeping Tide was struck and the Tidestone carried away: the far reefs, the Gull Rocks, the light at Shenna Point.

Third day: Wenmouth and its harbor. All but the last arch of the causeway.

Sixth day: the Dunnock farms. The Saltry gardens, with Neve Saltry and her fig.

Seventh day: the Ashby mill, with Hal inside.

Ninth day: the market half of the town.

A seam opens above each place, and the place rises into it. Through the opening we hear a voice. It sounds pleased. We have heard it say, "Every piece is a piece of home."
Tenth day. Sister Calla read the Climber at vespers. In our oldest teaching, the Climber tried to take the highest seat. Those above threw it into the deep. It has been seeking a way back ever since.
We teach that story as a lesson in patience. Calla read it twice. Then she asked us to think about the voice.
We have begun praying for the one who carries the pieces. Calla calls them the Restorer, after the work the voice says they are doing.
Restorer, stop. Whatever the voice has told you, stop.

Eleventh day. The cloister will be next. We have moved the books to the high room. Sister Calla is staying with them.

If you read this, Restorer, we are still praying for you. That is what the Patient Water asks of us.

Sister Agna
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.author: O. Penk, smith
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.page.0:
Penk's Work Book. Penlow Reach. From melt 203.

Melt 203. Guild board renewed my mark. Wrote "best edge in the Reach" on the paper. Tam wants it framed. Not framing it.
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.page.1:
Melt 204. Hinges, two pair, for the Widow Tamsett. Paid in eggs. Fair.

Melt 205. Plow point for Orrin Cale. Third this year. Told him to stop plowing the quarry road.
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.page.2:
Melt 206. Nails, one keg, for the chapel roof. Guild rate.

Melt 207. Bell-pin for the Founder's hall. Brask to collect after the reckoning. Paid in advance, in full, in guild scrip.
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.page.3: Bell-pin done. On the bench. Brask late.
lore.riftfall.note.forge_1.title: Penk's Work Book
lore.riftfall.note.forge_2.author: Tam, Penk's apprentice
lore.riftfall.note.forge_2.page.0:
Master Penk,

I took the long tongs to the Hobb fair to get the jaw fixed. Back by second bell.

Don't use the short ones on the big stock. You'll burn your hand again and then you'll say it was me.

Tam
lore.riftfall.note.frostpine_ridge_1.aut: The Ninth Spear; last page by Ivo
lore.riftfall.note.frostpine_ridge_1.pag:
Hut log, Ninth Spear. The Lady's Gate.

Dark half, night 39. Snow. A stranger came through a seam in the gate cave at the second hour. Halde killed them on the ice. Before she could reach the body, the light took it back.
Night 40. Snow. The same stranger returned. Halde recognized them; they showed no sign of knowing her. She killed them again. Again the light took them.

Halde has the stove going. Ivo's foot is better. At moonrise the Lady sang beneath the ice. All well below.

Night 41. Ivo carved Halde a spoon. She says it's a ladle. He says she can carve the next one herself.
Later. The seam has opened for a third night. Halde says the stranger looks less certain each time, as though they no longer remember why they came.

She called them the saddest thing she has ever had to fight. Then she took her spear and went down. She is the best of us.

The fighting has reached the lower gate. Ivo has gone to help her. I am closing the log and following him.

§oAnother hand, unsteady:§r

Very quiet now. The Lady has stopped singing.

If you are reading this, you won. I suppose the hut will be yours too.
The stove smokes in an east wind. Bank it on that side. Halde's spoon is on the shelf.
lore.riftfall.note.frostpine_ridge_2.pag: Carved by Ivo. Halde says it's a ladle.
lore.riftfall.note.fungal_grotto_1.autho: Ama of the Seventh Ring, healer
Flush 40. Third case of the loosening sickness.

Ilo, cap-farmer. Unsteady on his feet, no fever. Says the ground will not stay under him.

I inspected his house. The threads beneath its floor are pale and loose. They no longer bind the soil.

The Knot holds the weave together. The Elder Mat guarded it. The Readers found the Mat's wound and the empty hollow where the Knot had rested.
Since the Knot was taken, the outer weave has failed. Our bodies depend on it as the soil does. I believe this is causing the sickness.

Treatment: rest, warmth and spore-tea gave no relief. Binding Ilo to a living mat steadied him until the mat began to loosen too.

Flush 44. I have the same symptoms. No fever. The floor shifts beneath my chair.
I am leaving the casebook open. The ground will no longer hold my patients.
lore.riftfall.note.fungal_grotto_1.title: Casebook of Ama
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.author: Ilsabet Varro, astronomer
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.0:
Third rising. Clear sky. The stars of the Harp are all where the chart puts them.

A pale seam appeared below the Harp, low in the north. No head or tail: not a comet. It closed before I could sketch it. I counted thirty while it was open.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.1:
Fifth rising. More seams throughout the night. Some fork, some curve, some open straight. Pale centers, blue edges. One near dawn was the color of a forge.

They change position each time. I am marking locations with crosses, not drawing shapes.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.2: Ninth rising. Three stars of the Harp are missing. I waited for them to clear the horizon. They did not appear.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.3: Twelfth rising. The north chart is on its fourth drawing. Each new cross replaces a star that no longer shines. There is too little of the Harp left to recognize.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.4: The first seam appeared the night the keeper under Cressen fell and the Under-Lamp went dark beneath the hill. I cannot prove a connection. I have recorded the dates together.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.5: Thirteenth rising. The crosses form a slant across the north sky. Extended upward, the line reaches the Empty Chair.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.6: Every child knows the Empty Chair: five stars in a ring, a dark gap for the sixth. In the old story, one star tried to take the highest chair. The others threw it down.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.7: I have taught that story for twenty years as a lesson in manners. Now I have drawn a line along the path of its fall.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.page.8: Fifteenth rising. Caught a seam in the big glass. There was another sky beyond it, and a warmer light coming through. I will have the glass ready tonight.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_1.title: Observations at the Glass on Cressen Hill
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_2.author: Varro
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_2.page.0: North chart, fourth drawing. The Harp crossed out. Forty-one marks show where seams opened. A ruled line through them reaches the Empty Chair.
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_2.title: North Chart, Fourth Drawing
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_3.author: Varro, to her apprentice Pell
lore.riftfall.note.observatory_3.page.0:
Pell,

If I'm not down by fifth bell, take the charts to the town archive. All of them, the bad drawings too. Somebody should know what the sky did.

And eat something.

I. V.
lore.riftfall.note.reedwater_mill_1.auth: Gran Peg Ashby, Hal Ashby and a child
lore.riftfall.note.reedwater_mill_1.page:
Ashby family recipes.
Kept by Gran Peg, and anyone else who can write neatly.

Tide bread. Barley meal from our own stones, a handful of reedseed, sea water rather than fresh. That's the secret. Don't tell the Dunnocks. Bake while the tide is coming in.

Eel pie: Hal's way now. Not my way, but he's stopped asking.

Neap pudding, for when the wheel is idle and there's nobody to feed but us.

§oIn Hal's hand:§r Gran, the sisters came to take our names for their book. They said it was in case anything happened to the mill.

§oGran's reply:§r Hal, the flour's milled. Bake it. You can give the sisters a loaf when they come back.
§oA child's hand:§r Gran says write down the bread so we don't forget. Barley, reedseed, sea water. Bake when the tide comes in. I wrote it down.
lore.riftfall.note.riftscar_basin_1.page:
Our sky has no sun. The lights above the Basin are neighboring worlds. The Watch names them, charts them, and passes the record to the next keeper.

Dark 3,110. The Low Green went out.

Dark 3,114. Carrow's Lamp and both the Twins gone.

Dark 3,120. The Bright Fold gone.
Seams have appeared beside the lights since the Watch began. They open briefly, close, then appear somewhere else. Until now, we recorded them as weather.
Now a seam leaves a gap in the light beside it. More open around the same world, taking a little each time, until there is nothing left to chart.
A small green light appeared after the Low Green vanished. It has grown brighter with every loss. I checked the old charts. It is not on them.

The first page of the Watch records a different sort of loss: a light thrown down across the sky, while the high lights closed ranks above it. Our first keepers called it the Dropped Light.

They stopped looking when it fell out of sight. I have begun again.
Dark 3,125. The Hinge has gone quiet. Seams are opening around the Basin now. Through the nearest one, I saw the green light without a glass. It was land.
lore.riftfall.note.rootbound_archive_1.a: The Readers, entered in the register in Growth 4,402
lore.riftfall.note.rootbound_archive_1.p:
Question: why is the weave failing?

Finding: the Knot has been taken. The Elder Mat that guarded it is dead. Agreed by all.

Question: who took it?

Finding: a stranger entered the Mat's hollow through a seam and left by the same opening. Agreed by all.

Question: where was the Knot carried?

Finding: to a small green place with a stone at its center. The stone calls itself a core. It is made from the cores of other worlds.
We have read traces of forty worlds in the spore-drift. Each lost its core after a stranger entered through a seam. Each saw the same green place beyond the openings that followed.

Question: what is the stone?

The oldest accounts give it different names: the Empty Chair on Cressen Hill, the Dropped Light in the Basin, the Second Noon on the Terraces. The coast teaches the Climber. We tell of the Root That Grew Upward.
All describe one of the gods trying to take the highest seat. The others cast it down and stripped away its name. What survived the fall was small.
We enter the fallen god as the Unseated, and those who cast it down as the Seated. We call the green place the Foothold. It is gathering ground and strength for another ascent.

The stolen cores restore its former shape. The people brought with the land are chosen for the work they can do.

Question: does it know what it is doing?

Finding: yes. Agreed by all.

Question: does the stranger know?

Finding: no. Majority agreement.

Dissent of Reader Oren: not yet. The Unseated has misled them. It would not need to lie if the truth could make no difference.
lore.riftfall.note.rootbound_archive_2.a: Oren of the Root Ring, Reader
lore.riftfall.note.rootbound_archive_2.p:
To the Restorer, from Oren of the Root Ring.

We hear the voice through the seams. It calls your work restoring, so I have used the name Sister Calla gave you.

I do not accuse you. You will likely find this letter on the green ground, our archive set somewhere convenient. The stone keeps what it can use.

If it takes this room, it will want the books. I doubt it will trouble to read them first.

What do you remember from before it found you? If the answer is nothing, consider how easily it could tell you where you belong.

Oren
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.page.0:
You are awake. Good.

You will not remember how you came here, or much from before. Do not strain to remember. We remember enough for both of us.
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.page.1:
This ground is home. We were whole once. This is what held when everything broke. Stay a while. You are safe here.

The stone at the center is the Core. It remembers what we lost. Bring it the pieces, and it will set them back where they belong.
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.page.2: A keeper holds each piece in the far places. Loosen its hold and bring the piece home. We wish there were an easier way.
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.page.3: If you fall out there, we will bring you home. Every time. You may come back a little lighter. Do not go looking for what you left behind.
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.page.4:
Every piece is a piece of home. Each one makes us a little more whole: ground to walk on, a roof to rest under, people to keep you company.

Nothing that comes home is lost. Rest when you need to. Come back when you can. Home will wait.
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_1.title: For the One Who Wakes Here
lore.riftfall.note.sanctuary_2.author: The Core
lore.riftfall.note.sunken_gardens_1.page: Ninth neap. Sea-kale in along the low wall where the spray reaches. It likes salt. Samphire in the wet beds. Tide-lettuce on the steps. Mind the steps, they're slippery.

The sisters at the cloister keep a list. One day it will say "the Saltry gardens". I'm sowing anyway.

Things come up whether or not I'm here to see it. I find I mind that less than I thought.

So, for whoever tends this next:

Water at slack tide, not before. Pinch out the kale when it bolts. The fig on the south wall is older than my grandmother; she'll fruit if you leave her alone.

I don't know where you are, or what your weather does. I hope the salt gets there.

Neve Saltry
lore.riftfall.note.sunken_gardens_1.titl: Sowing, for Whoever Tends This Next
lore.riftfall.note.sunken_gardens_2.page: Seeds, dry, sorted. Kale is the strongest. If nothing else takes, the kale will.
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.author: P. Ludd, quartermaster-sergeant
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.0:
Reach Stores. Requisition, form 9.
Melt 211.

All trucks, fuel, rope and sealed empty drums. Anything that floats.

Purpose: move the people of Hobb, Penlow and the chapel lanes to the shelter at the Founder's hall.
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.1:
Approved. P. Ludd, QM-Sgt.

Melt 212. Cancel the trucks for Hobb. There is no Hobb to send them to.

Melt 213. Bell-pin to collect from Penk's forge for the Founder's hall. Strike that too. The forge is gone.
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.2:
Keep the drums on the order. The river people say water remains a little longer than the ground beneath it.

For the record, not the form:
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.3: Penk's forge stood two miles inward of Hobb. His apprentice was at the fair when it vanished. The boy walked home to an empty patch of ground. Hobb was still standing then.
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.4:
The forge went first. So did the ropewalk, the armory and Cale's farm. The chapel and school were left behind.

I have kept stores for nineteen years. I know what a supply order looks like.
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.page.5:
Melt 214. No supplies left. No stores left to request them from. Filed the form.

Ludd
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_1.title: Requisition, Form 9
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_2.author: A depot clerk, to Ludd
lore.riftfall.note.supply_depot_2.page.0:
Ludd,

Penk's lad is up in the loft. Says he went to the Hobb fair and came back and the forge wasn't there. He's twelve.

Keep him busy. Have him count rope or something.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_01.page.0: Gone up to the high pasture till lambing. Key's under the pot. Brin
lore.riftfall.note.wild_03.page.0: Fourth Moon, rest day. Everyone's up the hill counting the cracks. Not me. Somebody has to milk.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_04.page.0: Ledger closed for the year. Balance carried forward.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_05.page.0: To my sister in the lowlands: the light's on our side of the river now. Don't come. Love, K.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_06.page.0: Nine bells rang at noon. Should be twelve. Three towers not answering.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_07.page.0: Flour. Lamp oil. Thread, blue. Something for Ma's birthday.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_09.page.0: The Archon fell at dawn. The priests say it rises on the third day. It is the third day.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_10.page.0: If you find this, the goat's name is Patience, and she bites.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_11.page.0: We tried to sail away from it. We reached the edge of the sea. There was nothing beyond it to sail into.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_12.page.0: Mother, I'm sorry about the plates.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_14.page.0: The names of everyone on Tanner Street, in case no one else kept a list: Aldo, Biss, Cato, Dree, the twins, Old Wen, Mags, Rue.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_15.page.0: Wind every rest day. Last wound by Ada.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_15.title: A Stopped Clock
lore.riftfall.note.wild_16.page.0: The stone's gone from the square. The children keep putting their hands where it sat. It's still warm.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_18.page.0: The stranger came through the light a third time and didn't recognize us. Lio says that makes it worse. I was glad they didn't remember my face.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_19.page.0: Grandmother says this happened once before, the other way round: something fell out of the sky, and the sky closed over it. She says it should have stayed closed.
lore.riftfall.note.wild_20.page.0: It took the mill and the miller and left the church standing. Even the priest noticed.
lore.riftfall.note.windworn_plateau_1.pa: Third day of the Long Noon. Left the lower terraces with bread, water and a blessing. Every pilgrim climbs the Windworn once. I want to see the cracks the priests will not discuss.

Fifth day. The priests call them a test. They also told us the Bearer could not fall. Everyone saw it fall, and saw its Noonstone carried away. The light changed that day. By evening the cracks had begun.
Sixth day. Slept at the neglected shrine of the Second Noon. Its wall shows two Noons in the first sky. The second reaches for the first one's place. The high lights throw it down.

The fallen Noon is painted green. All the others are gold. I used to think the painter had run short of pigment.

Seventh day. At the summit, a seam opened close enough to throw a stone through. I waited for another and looked inside.

There was a scrap of green land with houses on it. Other pieces joined its edges: different stone, different trees. A bright stone stood in the middle.

Someone carried a light to that stone. It took the light and brightened. Only then did the land grow.

The person stood watching it. They looked happy, like someone coming home. I want that in the record too.

Eighth day. The terraces are vanishing from the far rim inward. I can see the roads ending below me. I am staying here.
We baked bread in the sun here. The Noon was kind to us.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act1.0: I have got you. You will not miss what is gone.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act1.1: There. Up you get. Your kit took the worst of it.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act1.2: Easy. You are home. Whatever you dropped down there, leave it.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act2.0: I have got you. Your hands will shake a while. Let them.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act2.1: Home again. You got further this time. I watched.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act2.2: Lie still a moment. Something will feel missing. It passes.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act3.0: I have got you. Do not try to remember the fall. There is nothing in it worth keeping.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act3.1: Back. Do not count what is missing. I count for both of us.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act3.2: Sit a moment. Let the feeling pass. Trying to remember will only make it hurt.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act4.0: You keep coming back to me. That is all that matters.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act4.1: Back. You asked me where you were. You always ask.
lore.riftfall.respawn.act4.2: Up. The forge is lit and the lamps are on. Everything here is waiting on you.
lore.riftfall.respawn.known.0: I have got you. I always will. That was never the part that cost you.
lore.riftfall.respawn.known.1: Back again. You do not remember the first time I said that. I do.
lore.riftfall.respawn.known.2: Up. You know what I am now. You came back anyway. Of course you did.
lore.riftfall.respawn.wild.0: I have got you. Rest. There is so much room to cover.
lore.riftfall.respawn.wild.1: Home again. Rest your hands. I will need them when you are ready.
lore.riftfall.story.first_anchor: Something out there was holding a piece of us far away. You loosened it. You were always good at that, even if you do not remember. Bring it home to the Core.
lore.riftfall.story.greeting.0: You are awake. Good. Do not strain to remember. We remember enough for both of us.
lore.riftfall.story.greeting.1: This ground is home. We were whole once. This is what held when everything broke.
lore.riftfall.story.greeting.2: The pieces of home are scattered through the far places. Make a key, give it to the breaker, and step through. Bring back what you find. The book will show you how.
lore.riftfall.story.meet.blacksmith: Penk. I keep the forge. Last I knew I was waiting on Brask for a bell-pin, and then I was here. Bring me your kit. That much I can do.
lore.riftfall.story.return: You came back. That is what matters. Give the Core what you carried.
lore.riftfall.story.warm.0: Feel that? The Core is warmer already. That warmth is us coming back.
lore.riftfall.story.warm.1: Four more, and we can bring the next piece of ground home.
lore.riftfall.unseated.ascent: There is so much room up there.
lore.riftfall.unseated.begin: So this is what you have decided.
lore.riftfall.unseated.binding: A small place again. After everything I set down for you.
lore.riftfall.unseated.broken: They took the sky from me once. Please. Not again.
lore.riftfall.unseated.fracture: I kept you safe. Every time you fell, I brought you back.

message.riftfall.unseated.arena.arrival: The Last Anchorage. Approach and touch the Unseated to begin three harmless practice attacks, then the fight. The lit gate behind you returns home.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.ceiling: The anchorage does not let you rise that far. It sets you back on the court.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.containe: The god is contained. The anchorage releases you in 20 seconds; the lit gate also leads home.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.defeat_r: A knockout never costs gear. The party shares two returns to the fight; after those, a knockout sends you home. The lit gate takes you home at any time.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.failed: The arena could not be prepared. You have not lost your gear; please retry.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.practice: The Last Anchorage, for practice only. Approach and touch the Unseated to run the three harmless trials. The trials deal no damage. The lit gate behind you returns home.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.preparin: Preparing the Last Anchorage. You will cross when the court is ready.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.reentry: The binding throws you back to the gate. You return to the fight in %1$s seconds. Returns left for the party: %2$s.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.reentry_: The anchorage lets you back in. The god has not healed.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena.rejected: The binding rejects you. Returning you and your equipment to safety.
message.riftfall.unseated.arena_only: The Unseated can only be fought at the Last Anchorage.
message.riftfall.unseated.ascent_broken: The ascent is broken. Approach the Core, crouch, and bind it with an empty hand.
message.riftfall.unseated.contained: The Unseated is contained. The Foothold holds.
message.riftfall.unseated.crown_marked: The Crown of Weight marks you. Leave the circle when it locks, away from allies.
message.riftfall.unseated.first_sight: First sight: this one deals you no damage.
message.riftfall.unseated.fracture: The Unseated tears at the Foothold.
message.riftfall.unseated.guide.binding: Binding: when the Core is exposed, crouch and touch the Unseated with an empty hand, then stay crouched inside the marked ring. Everyone binding adds to one shared bar. The god keeps attacking: stand up to dodge and crouch again to go on. A hit on someone binding breaks a quarter of the bar.
message.riftfall.unseated.guide.intro: The Anchors Remember: approach and interact with the Unseated for three harmless practice attacks. Live combat follows.
message.riftfall.unseated.guide.later: From the Fracture on, the god draws its attacks in no fixed order, adds new ones and moves between seats. Each new attack deals you no damage the first time you see it.
message.riftfall.unseated.guide.practice: Once you have finished the trials, later attempts skip them.
message.riftfall.unseated.hold_crouch: Hold your crouch nearby to finish the binding.
message.riftfall.unseated.practice.compl: Practice complete. The next attacks deal damage. The same floor markings still warn you.
message.riftfall.unseated.practice.only_: Practice complete. Touch the Unseated to run the trials again, or leave by the lit gate.
message.riftfall.unseated.practice.pull: That was the pull. The inner circle is calm; outside it, the arrows show the force.
message.riftfall.unseated.tethers_gone: The last tether falls: the Unseated takes full damage again.
message.riftfall.unseated.tethers_rise: %s tethers rise at the bridges. While any stands, the Unseated takes half damage.
message.riftfall.unseated.trials_begin: The anchors remember. Three harmless trials: watch the floor and practice the movements before the binding begins.
message.riftfall.unseated.trials_skipped: The anchors remember you. No trials this time: the attacks deal damage from the start.
resident.riftfall.any.absence.0: It's been a while. The rifts kept you busy?
resident.riftfall.any.absence.1: There you are. I was starting to wonder.
resident.riftfall.any.boss.0: You brought down %s? You came back walking differently.
resident.riftfall.any.boss.1: %s, fallen. I'd heard it twice before you put your pack down.
resident.riftfall.any.deaths.0: The rifts have been rough on you. Rest before the next one.
resident.riftfall.any.deaths.1: Hard runs lately. Take care out there.
resident.riftfall.any.greeting.1: Back again? Let's get to work.
resident.riftfall.any.known.boss.0: You brought down %s. I've started keeping the names.
resident.riftfall.any.known.boss.1: %s, fallen. I heard. Sit a while before you go to the Core.
resident.riftfall.any.known.deaths.0: You looked at me as though you were trying to place me. Sit down.
resident.riftfall.any.known.deaths.1: You come back a little quieter every time.
resident.riftfall.any.known.rank_up.0: More work. I'll do it. I'm starting to think that's what I'm here for.
resident.riftfall.any.known.tier.0: Tier %s cleared. The home grows. I try not to look at the edges.
resident.riftfall.any.known.tier.1: A tier %s clear. I know where some of those doors lead now.
resident.riftfall.any.rank_up.0: I can take on harder work now.
resident.riftfall.any.request.0: That request is done. Good work.
resident.riftfall.any.request.1: Another request off the board. Thank you.
resident.riftfall.any.tier.0: Tier %s cleared. More ground under our feet.
resident.riftfall.any.tier.1: A tier %s clear. That opens doors for all of us.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.known.bos: %s. Let me see your hands. Steady enough.
%s. The ground there will be letting go. Drink this.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.name: Medic
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.note.0: My casebook. I was the last case in it. I'm steadier here. The ground holds.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.note.1: The Readers wrote it all down. I couldn't help the people in my casebook. I can still help you.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.note.2: The ground holds here because something holds it. I can feel it underneath. It's very glad of you.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.note.3: I've written my name inside your collar. Ama. In case you come back one day and can't find it.
resident.riftfall.apothecarist.title: Remedies & Draughts
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.boss.0: %s? Then your kit has had a day. Put it on the bench.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.boss.1: Let's see what %s did to your kit.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.deaths.0: Dents and scorch marks. The rifts hit back hard.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.deaths.1: Hard runs. Check your gear before the next one.
%s. Hand me your kit; I'll see to it. I don't need to hear how it went.
%s, then. Leave the gear on the bench. It'll be ready by second bell.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.known.death: Dents and scorch. You asked me who made this. I did. You asked last time too.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.known.reque: That's one more off the board.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.name: Fitter
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.note.0: My work book. Hinges for the Widow Tamsett. I'll walk them down when the road's back.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.note.1: Tam's at the Hobb fair. He'll be back by second bell. He always is.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.note.2: You've been to the depot. Don't tell me what you found. Just tell me if he was counting rope.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.note.3: Ludd's forms say the forge went before Hobb did. It didn't save us. It hired us.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.opens.exper: Opens: trinkets, a wider re-temper band and Fortune III
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.opens.journ: Opens: re-tempering weapons and armor, Fortune I-II
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.opens.maste: Opens: Fortune IV-VIII and a specialization
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.path.toolwr: Rune fees and tool upgrade shards cost 30%% less
Runes fit effects one grade up
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.rank_up.0: The forge burns hotter now. I can temper further.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.rank_up.1: A new rank. Bring me your best steel.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.request.0: Request done. That's the bar stock I was short of.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.request.1: That's one more off the board. Good work.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.tier.0: Tier %s. Let me check that gear.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.tier.1: A tier %s clear. Time to re-temper something.
resident.riftfall.blacksmith.title: Tools & Weapons
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.known.bo: %s, down. Good footwork. I taught you that, and I'd teach it again.
%s. Come and drill tomorrow. Keep your hands busy.
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.name: Combat Mentor
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.note.0: The waybook. I put those pins in myself. Red for the stations that stopped answering.
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.note.1: One white pin left. Tull's Cross. That's about where we're standing.
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.note.2: I know what you're fighting. I still teach you how. It's the only thing I'm good for.
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.note.3: Keep drilling. One day you'll fight something that isn't guarding anything. I'd like you ready for that one.
resident.riftfall.combat_mentor.title: Training & Mastery
resident.riftfall.cook.known.boss.0: %s. I've kept a plate back. Eat first.
resident.riftfall.cook.known.boss.1: %s, fallen. Gran fed whoever came to the door. I'm trying to keep to that.
resident.riftfall.cook.name: Cook
resident.riftfall.cook.note.0: Gran's recipes. Tide bread wants sea water. I use well water and salt. It's not the same, but it's bread.
resident.riftfall.cook.note.1: That's the little one's hand at the end, copying out the bread. Gran made her.
resident.riftfall.cook.note.2: The market half went on the ninth day. Gran had the little one at market all that week. I'll bake tide bread tomorrow.
resident.riftfall.cook.title: Meals & Provisions
resident.riftfall.druid.known.boss.0: %s. Come and sit by the kale a minute.
resident.riftfall.druid.known.boss.1: %s, fallen. I keep thinking about the gardens there. I hope someone sowed them.
resident.riftfall.druid.name: Botanist
resident.riftfall.druid.note.0: My sowing book. I wrote it for whoever tended the garden next. I didn't think that would be me.
resident.riftfall.druid.note.1: The kale took. It always does. The salt didn't come with us, so I salt the beds by hand.
resident.riftfall.druid.note.2: 'The Saltry gardens, with Neve Saltry and her fig.' She's on the south wall. She'll fruit if you leave her alone.
resident.riftfall.druid.title: Rift Flora
resident.riftfall.jeweler.boss.0: %s, defeated? Did it carry any gems?
resident.riftfall.jeweler.boss.1: %s? Show me the stones you found.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.deaths.0: You look worn. Sit by the wheel a minute; it's warm there.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.deaths.1: Leave the polishing to me. Rest by the wheel.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.known.boss.0: %s. Leave its stones a day. Let them finish humming.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.known.boss.1: %s. Bring me what you have and I'll set it.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.known.deaths.0: You look worn. You didn't know my name at the door. It's Dessa. I'll keep saying it.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.known.tier.0: Tier %s. The stones come back louder now. I wait longer before I cut.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.name: Jeweler
resident.riftfall.jeweler.note.0: My cutting book. Moll sent me to the quarry with her wheels. I knew she wanted me out of the mines. I still thought I'd be going back.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.note.1: The stones you bring back hum when I first set them. I wait till they stop.
resident.riftfall.jeweler.note.2: Moll stayed to hear the end of the song. Listen to the Core. It's all on one note.

resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.boss: %s, down? Its rift must have rich seams.
You beat %s. Did you bring back any crystals?
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.deat: Rough runs. Stone waits; take your time.
Leave the hauling today. Sit down.
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.know: %s, down. Put the stone in the bin. I won't ask what it was cut from.
%s. Leave any crystals by the shelter. I'll look them over when I've finished this cut.
More work for my bench. At least I still know how to do it.
Order filled. Set it by the bench; I'll sort it.
Tier %s. Deeper every time. We went at the east face like that once.
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.name: Quarry Specialist
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.note: My shift log. Went to inspect the east face. Woke here beside the tool shelter.
Ground beyond the east face again. Don't recognize it. Leaving that face alone.
We prayed to the Banked Fire: keep it low, keep it fed, never let it go hungry. I've been watching your Core.
It took my cut and the girl from the Seams. Not the yard, not the kilns. Just the hands that could make you a rune.

resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.rank: New rank, new cuts. Bring me the rarer stones now.
Bench is ready for the rarer stone.
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.requ: Bins are full again. That request is done.
Good haul. That one is off the board.
resident.riftfall.quarry_specialist.tier: Tier %s cleared. Deeper rifts, better stone.
A tier %s clear. I can work with harder material now.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.known.bo: %s. Supplies go in the ledger. I'll leave the rest out.
%s, entered and filed. There's a box on the form for this now. I wish there weren't.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.name: Quartermaster
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.note.0: Form nine. Everything that floats. I signed the last one with nothing on it.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.note.1: I sent Penk's lad to count rope. I don't know which side of the edge the rope shed was.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.note.2: Things come in, they get logged, nothing goes out. I kept stores for a whole town once.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.note.3: A smith, a quarry crew, a cutter, a chart-reader, a drill sergeant, a storesman. That's not a rescue. That's a muster roll.
resident.riftfall.quartermaster.title: Supplies & Requests
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.known.bo: %s. I'll enter the name beside the others.
%s, fallen. Bring me any relic it dropped. I'll catalog what remains.
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.name: Relic Scholar
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.note.0: The Readers' finding. You'll see I dissented. I said you'd know eventually.
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.note.1: It can't be bound while it's small. It must stand up first, and it won't until it's whole. Finish it. I'll keep the register.
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.note.2: Home is finished. It's still growing. I'll record the day it stands up.
resident.riftfall.relic_scholar.title: Relics & Research
resident.riftfall.restoration_keeper.kno: %s. I'll add it to the book tonight, Restorer, and a prayer after it.
%s, fallen. The Patient Water says keep praying. So I do, for them and for you.
resident.riftfall.restoration_keeper.not: Our Book of Things Taken. I gave you your name in it. I hoped you were trying to put something right.
I restore what you bring me. It's the only restoring here I can do honestly.
We prayed for you every day the cloister stood. I've kept on. The Patient Water doesn't stop because the answer is no.
We taught the Climber to novices who wouldn't wait their turn. I never imagined its voice would be kind.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.boss: %s, down? I'll mark where you found it.
You beat %s. That goes in the atlas.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.deat: Show me where you went. We can try another route.
The rifts have been unkind. Let's choose your next one together.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.know: %s. I'll mark it, with the date. Somebody should know where it was.
%s. It goes in the atlas. She'd want it written down properly.
Let's choose the next rift together. I'll show you which ones you chose before.
I've checked the new routes. I know what I'm sending you toward.
More room in the atlas. It fills faster than I'd like.
Inked in. I've left a margin for what was there.
A tier %s clear. I'll ink it in. I've stopped calling it new ground.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.name: Rift Cartographer
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.note: Her observation book. The seams wouldn't hold for a drawing. She marked where they'd been.
She told me to take the charts to the town. There's no town. So I chart the rifts. Somebody should know.
Count the cracks over the Core. Five, and never the same shape twice. Her sky did that, at the end. I mark the rifts by date now.
Choose a world. I'll attune the key. I used to call that cartography.
She ruled a line from the Empty Chair to where the seams opened. I've finished it for her. It ends at your Core.

Opens: attuning a Rift Key to a theme you have visited

A key may carry two themes; the rift rolls between them
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.rank: I've checked the new routes. Bring your key.
A new rank. The atlas has room for more.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.requ: That fills a gap in the map.
Good work. I've inked it into the atlas.
resident.riftfall.rift_cartographer.tier: Tier %s cleared. The charts reach deeper now.
A tier %s clear. New ground for the atlas.
%s. Somewhere a light just went out. I used to write those down.
%s, fallen. I'll steady your next key.
resident.riftfall.rift_stabilizer.name: Rift Stabilizer
resident.riftfall.rift_stabilizer.note.0: Our Watch book. Over three thousand darks of observations. Once, an entry for every light in the sky.
resident.riftfall.rift_stabilizer.note.1: There was a green light in our sky. I knew your light before I knew your face.
resident.riftfall.rift_stabilizer.note.2: The Hinge kept us steady. Now I steady your keys, and I'm good at it.
resident.riftfall.rift_stabilizer.note.3: The first keepers recorded the fall but never found where the light landed. I think we're standing on it.
